request.text: An implant-like PowerShell on WORKSTATION5 is enumerating the domain's user accounts. Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: A high-integrity PowerShell of pgustavo (PID 7456) opened and started net.exe user /domain, which ran net1 user /domain, to list every account of the domain from WORKSTATION5. This is domain account discovery by an implant-like PowerShell; isolate WORKSTATION5 now.
